title: Mountain Lion - Me time
description: In 2022, I had the opportunity to work on my first show at Milk VFX for the Netflix film "Me Time," featuring Kevin Hart and Mark Wahlberg. One memorable sequence involved Kevin being chased by a mountain lion while cuddling her cub, which prompted the need for creating realistic CG animals. I was responsible for modeling both the mountain lion and the cub, utilizing FACS deconstructed shapes for realistic facial expressions. I collaborated with an exceptional team, including VFX supervisor Ciaran Crowley, Creature supervisor Neil Roche, Rigging/CFX Jared Embley, Texturing Kevin San, animation supe Chris Hutchinson and Matt Bell on Groom, Sian Fenner in Production, and more.

title: Albert Einstein
description:
Einstein project for client Smart Energy, I was contracted by The Mill London in 2020, to bring legendary Albert Einstein to digital self. I was responsible for modeling, sculpting and facial shapes for the Einstein. It was equally legendary team with supervision of Alex Hammond(3D) and Ben Turner(2D), Andreas on rigging, Clare (facial animation), Maria (texturing/lookdev/lighting) and Sefki(groom/lookdev). In production it was Chris Allen(exec producer) and Sean Francis(senior prod coord).

I also helped with the facial scan data shoot and FACS based dataset preparation. We scanned each FACS poses, this time not static but 4d volumetric captures, so once the shapes go into the rig, each shapes is full of in-betweens, and not linear. Giving more believable facial deformations. This show also gave me an opportunity to help develop facial modelling toolset, nicknamed MillFACS.

Honored to win the VES award under 'Outstanding Animated Character in a Commercial' category.

title: Lebron James Super bowl
description:
Another splendid project at The Mill for Super Bowl. We had to recreate legendary young LeBron James talking to his older self. Due to time constraint of Super Bowl fast approaching, we had ridiculously tight deadline and had to pull off a realistic looking famous personality's talking CG face. No pressure right? We took a nonorthodox facial animation approach on this project for first time. And it worked!
We also had a tight but talented team. The model was sculpted by the renowned Kris Costa, and I was responsible for faceshapes and shot-sculpting.

title: Fantastic Beasts and Where To Find Them
description: I was responsible for Gnarlak's facial shapes at Framestore. This character was based on the great Ron Perlman(Hellboy). His FACS session was recorded which helped us study deformations on his face, which were then sculpted to his goblin version.  The model was made by Victor Hernandez.

title: Film Modelling Demoreel
description:
My works as Lead Character/Creature modeller in Film VFX
1. Guardians of the Galaxy: Framestore: I modelled rocket in collaboration with other character artists. I was also responsible for his face shapes(FACS) working closely with rigging department
2. Paddington : Framestore : I modelled the dog he is carrying in tube station. And paddington’s essential Suitcase
3. Legend of Tarzan : Framestore : I sculpted facial and hands details for mother gorilla Kala. I also sculpted her face shapes(FACS). I was responsible for shotsculpting fixes for Tarzan digidouble
4. Pan : Framestore : I was primary sculptor on the infamous crocodile
5. Fantastic Beasts : Framestore : I was primary face shapes(FACS) artist on Gnarlak(based on Ron Perlman’s performance)
6. Men Women and Children : Framesotre: I was solely responsible for detailed model of Voyager 1 spaceship
7. Guardians of the Galaxy 2 : Framestore : Rocket Raccoon faceshapes
8. Lion King : MPC : Lead Creature modeller

title: Men Women and Children
description:
I solely modelled Voyager 1 spaceship which is featured on the opening sequence for the film Men Women and Children.
It is based on real life space probe launched in 1977, and the only human made object to be farthest from earth. It has been travelling for 40 years and currently is on the edge of our solar system in Interstellar space.
The probe carries a gold-plated audio-visual disc in case the spacecraft should ever be found by intelligent life forms from other planetary systems.
